customManagers.description: ansible pinned in the Dockerfile pip install

packageRules.description: Galaxy collections are pinned to match the bundled ansible package version; bump them by hand together with ansible, not independently
ansible 10 / ansible-core 2.17 supports controller Python <=3.12 — only allow digest/patch bumps of the base image, move Python minors by hand together with ansible
ansible major bumps change the bundled collection set — manual review via the dependency dashboard
